BaseURL.title: Totara Site URL
BaseURL.description: Your Totara site's own base URL, e.g. 'https://learn.your-org.com'. The connector calls '{BaseURL}/webservice/rest/server.php' - Totara is self-hosted per customer, so there is no shared default.

Token.title: Web Service Token (wstoken)
Token.description: A Totara/Moodle web service token (wstoken) for a user with the required REST function permissions. Generated in Totara under Site administration > Server > Web services > Manage tokens.
